actions.name: Dual Wield

cost.trigger: The user declares a @Trait[missile], @Trait[pulse], or @Trait[ray] attack.

actions.description:
Trigger: The user declares a @Trait[missile], @Trait[pulse], or @Trait[ray] attack.

Effect: The user spends 1 PP as an @Trait[interrupt] at @Trait[flinch-30]. If the declared Attack lacks @Trait[double-strike] or @Trait[x-strike], the attack loses -30% Base Power and gains @Trait[double-strike] until it is resolved (using @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-effects.58tqKMnWTwQJgAC6]{Dual Wield (Single Strike)}).

If the declared Attack already possessed @Trait[double-strike] or @Trait[x-strike], the attack instead gains +30% Base Power and EHR and gains +1 minimum and +3 maximum hits until it is resolved (using @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-effects.ojm5vuWcgyYbey6P]{Dual Wield (Multi-Strike)}).
